description: Top-down view of the Path Analytics ingestion pipeline (RA Collector -> Roadrunner -> Fedex -> Kafka -> Sky-Topo -> Gather -> Druid). Includes RA Collector connectivity diagnostics for Path Analytics, Sky-Topo topology processing, and segment assignment. Swarm deployment.

options.content:
# Path Analytics Ingestion Pipeline
RA source → RA Collector → Roadrunner → Fedex → input Kafka → Sky-Topo → output Kafka → Druid.

**Triage:** check scrape/schema coverage, then failures, row outcomes and activity. Zero can mean idle; messages and rows use different units.

Gather provides dictionary/query context. Kafka acknowledgements do not prove Druid ingestion.

panels.title: Pipeline activity (cadence and stage units differ)

panels.description: Worst reported PA connection status in the selected tenant scope: 1 connected, 0 disconnected. Missing collectors still require configuration and health investigation.
panels.title: 1 · RA Collector (edge)

panels.description: Events sent to Roadrunner in the last collector health cycle. This is a collect-and-reset gauge, not a five-minute counter. Zero can reflect idle; check connection health separately.
panels.title: 2 · RA → Roadrunner

panels.description: Reported file-processing count in the last five minutes. Zero can reflect idle. This stage uses different units from RA messages and rows.
panels.title: 3 · Roadrunner → Fedex

panels.description: Fedex-reported RA record count in the last five minutes, scoped by tenant/type. This is not independent proof of broker acknowledgement; zero can reflect idle.
panels.title: 4 · Fedex RA records

panels.description: Source-message receipt attempts. A message can contain many rows. Zero can mean idle.
panels.title: 5 · Sky-Topo input messages

panels.description: Acknowledged output calls, not Druid ingestion or unique delivery. Zero can mean idle.
panels.title: 6 · Sky-Topo → Kafka rows

panels.description: Per-collector status table. Each row is one RA collector showing connectivity, configuration, and health.
panels.title: Collector Status

panels.description: Topology events consumed from PA vs successfully sent to Roadrunner per 30s cycle. A growing gap means events are being dropped (check whitelist/duplicate panels).
panels.title: RA Collector – Events Consumed vs Sent

panels.description: Events filtered out: unprovisioned (not in whitelist) and duplicated (same data already sent). High unprovisioned count means the connector config doesn't match the PA topology.
panels.title: RA Collector – Whitelist & Duplicate Drops

panels.description: Events that triggered aggregation and the time spent per reduction. High aggregation time may indicate performance bottleneck.
panels.title: RA Collector – Aggregation

panels.description: Configured update cadence in seconds. This controls how frequently the collector sends batches.
panels.title: RA Collector – Update Cadence

panels.description: Average time to read events from the gRPC stream per 30s cycle.
panels.title: RA Collector – Event Read Time

panels.description: Average time to process a segment per 30s cycle.
panels.title: RA Collector – Segment Processing Time

panels.description: Average time to process a full batch per 30s cycle.
panels.title: RA Collector – Batch Processing Time

panels.description: Average SQLite persistence time per 30s cycle. High values indicate disk I/O pressure.
panels.title: RA Collector – Persistence Usage

panels.description: Number of segments processed per 30s cycle.
panels.title: RA Collector – Segments Processed

panels.description: File processing rate and record count by objectType from Roadrunner.
panels.title: Sensor Collector – Throughput

panels.description: Roadrunner connection status to PCA platform.
panels.title: Sensor Collector – Connection to PCA

panels.description: Cached files and available batches in Roadrunner persistence. Growing backlog = downstream (Fedex) not consuming fast enough.
panels.title: Sensor Collector – Persistence Cache Backlog

panels.description: Data dropped by Roadrunner, broken down by reason.
panels.title: Sensor Collector – Dropped Data (by reason)

panels.description: Records received by Fedex by objectType (ra_summary, ra_instance).
panels.title: Fedex – Records In (from Sensor Collectors)

panels.description: Messages Fedex produced to Kafka skytopo_raw_in topics.
panels.title: Fedex → Kafka Produced (msgs/s)

panels.description: Kafka producer errors from Fedex. Non-zero = data loss risk.
panels.title: Fedex – Kafka Produce Errors

panels.description: Batches rejected by Fedex due to unauthorized tenant, bad data, or internal errors.
panels.title: Fedex – Rejected Batches (by cause)

panels.description: Websocket teardowns and rejections between Roadrunner and Fedex.
panels.title: Fedex – Sensor Collector Websocket Issues

panels.description: Topology records processed by Sky-Topo from Kafka.
panels.title: Sky-Topo – Acknowledged output rows/s (legacy)

panels.description: Legacy errors have no record_type label. This panel filters tenant only; use RA diagnostics below for type/stage/reason.
panels.title: Sky-Topo – Errors

panels.description: Current provisioned nodes vs maximum allowed. Hitting the max means new topology nodes will be rejected.
panels.title: Sky-Topo – Current Nodes vs Max

panels.description: Average time to provision a new topology node.
panels.title: Sky-Topo – Node Provisioning Duration

panels.description: Messages received in the selected range; not unique records.
panels.title: Source message attempts

panels.description: Producer acknowledged the call; not Druid ingestion or deduplicated delivery.
panels.title: Acknowledged output rows

panels.description: Actual row exits before publication. Source decode failures have unknown row count.
panels.title: Skipped rows

panels.description: A failed call can have an uncertain broker outcome; this is not a measured loss count.
panels.title: Failed output calls

panels.description: Failure/quality events in the selected range, not unique failed rows. Numeric diagnostics can occur while every row is published.
panels.title: Diagnostic events

panels.description: At least one acknowledged and one failed output call in the same source attempt. Replay/duplicate risk, not duplicate count.
panels.title: Partial publication attempts

panels.description: Deployment scope, not tenant scope. 0: scrape failed; no data: target absent. Inspect active targets before reading counters.
panels.title: Sky-Topo scrape coverage

panels.description: Presence only: 0 means no configured processor or an older/missing metric schema. Check configuration/version. Scrape health is a separate panel. This zero fallback is only for explicit schema-presence detection, never ingestion errors.
panels.title: RA schema presence (deployment)

panels.description: Consuming includes waiting for input. Missing rows require source/version/scrape investigation; tenant selection is not authorization.
panels.title: Configured processor state

panels.description: Positive start means an active source attempt. No data can be idle or missing telemetry: check configured state and scrape coverage. 60s is a QA diagnostic threshold, not an SLO.
panels.title: Current processing age

panels.description: Per source/instance. Zero: not seen since processor creation. Old output without new input can be healthy event-driven inactivity.
panels.title: Last input

panels.description: Per source/instance. Zero: not seen since processor creation. Old output without new input can be healthy event-driven inactivity.
panels.title: Last acknowledged output

panels.description: Actual row outcomes. Numeric diagnostics can coexist with published rows; no packet-loss ratio.
panels.title: Row outcomes / second

panels.description: Events, not distinct failed rows. A row can have multiple numeric diagnostics and a serialization failure. Only positive increments are plotted; use the event total and coverage panels to distinguish zero events from missing telemetry.
panels.title: Diagnostic events by stage / reason

panels.description: MarkMessage calls, not actual broker commits, transactions, or a new drop/retry policy. Empty-source is distinct from error discards.
panels.title: Offset mark requests

panels.description: Acknowledged and failed output calls in one attempt. Does not count global duplicates.
panels.title: Partial-publication risk over time

options.content: **Observability only.** Quantities and activity times answer different questions. One source message can contain multiple rows; input minus output is not packet loss. Check scrape/schema coverage first. No new input and no active attempt can mean **idle**, especially for `ra_instance`. Numeric quality diagnostics may coexist with published rows. A successful output call proves Kafka acknowledgement, not Druid ingestion or exactly-once delivery. Retry/replay and processing-policy changes are outside this MVP.

panels.description: Number of RA collector agents available for segment assignment.
panels.title: Available RA Agents

panels.description: Total number of discovered topology segments.
panels.title: Total Segments

panels.description: Target number of segments each RA agent should handle.
panels.title: Target Segments/Agent

panels.description: Segments not assigned to any RA agent. Non-zero means some topology is not being monitored.
panels.title: Unassigned Segments

panels.description: Ingestion requests Gather has read, by changeType.
panels.title: Gather – Ingest Requests Read (APPEND/REFRESH)

panels.description: Druid ingestion submissions: success vs failure.
panels.title: Gather – Submit Success vs Fail

panels.description: Pacemaker queue depth. Growing queue = Druid not keeping up.
panels.title: Gather – Pacemaker Queue Size
Druid capacity (context; not RA row-delivery proof)

panels.description: Available Druid middlemanager task slots. 0 = all slots busy, new ingestion tasks will queue.
panels.title: Druid – Middlemanager Slot Availability

panels.description: Druid tasks exceeding expected duration (refresh > 30min, delta > 5min).
panels.title: Druid – Tasks Taking Too Long
